src: First, you need the Fabled Drumstick.
Head to the underground section of the Hub.
Use the Bouncy Mushroom to take you to the clouds above the fountain.
Jump into the barrel of the cannon that aims towards the front gate.
Head to the group of bee dogs and walk onto the honeycomb to transform into a bee dog.
Note that some of the jumps may be easier with the Speed Boost that spawns during the race.
Head to the underground section of the Hub.
Fly to the tree on an elevated platform, and fertilize the Secret Tree with the drumstick in exchange for the apple.
